training.lambda_selection: frozen previous dev-selected Mixed lambda per graph/cell/weighting
training.gamma_selection: none; report every prespecified gamma, without test selection
training.transition_loss: categorical NLL of repair/damage/stay; native predictive probabilities, no gold conditioning
training.brier_loss: mean of binary repair and damage Brier scores; stay term excluded
training.brier_selection: none; all prespecified coefficients are reported

evaluation.reference: valid-answer plurality, earliest observed answer wins ties

study.baseline: frozen Mixed and all transition-NLL arms from p1_transitions; NLL beta=1 fixed paired comparator

selection: Frozen Mixed/all transition-NLL arms; fixed lambda; all Brier beta arms; restart by penalized train loss
